'''2012 European Championship Morten Iversen DS Imperial Occupation (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Morten Iversen]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Occupation (V) / Imperial Control (V)|SE-D-imperialoccupation.gif|label=Imperial Occupation (V)}}
* '''Username:''' Zenith
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 8.1]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
